source_text: Tensions arise from interpretive variances: while hadith support khitan, the Quran's emphasis on unaltered creation (e.g., Surah 95:4) has prompted some reformist arguments questioning its necessity, suggesting potential misalignment with bodily sacredness (hurmat al-jasad) absent explicit divine mandate. [13]
